scope: Historical identity evidence and required inputs; not a conforming core process or live-provider fixture

historicalEvidence.meaning: Trace and source observations, not frozen current executable identities or compatibility ranges

sourceToPreserve.role: original Wright source, retained unchanged as provenance when explicitly supplied
sourceToPreserve.sourceTaskKind: AI-directed CAD task; a fixed-call variant needs explicit authorship, not assumed equivalence

intendedOutcome.handoff: The same explicitly identified resulting document and revision
intendedOutcome.export: STEP output with separately stated acceptance; file creation alone is insufficient

requiredCapture: Authorized original source and native model bytes with provenance and exact digests
Frozen provider binary and dependency identities including relevant uncommitted changes
Actual supported MCP protocol negotiation and tools/list snapshots
Explicit solid_edge application identity/version and provider-specific resource evidence
Supported isolated execution environment, permissions and receiving connection
Explicitly authored fixed-call variant preserving exact provider, arguments and data handoff
Measured acceptance, original-file preservation, partial failure and unknown-mutation evidence

unavailableReceivingInstallation.condition: No verified compatible local or remote Solid Edge provider
unavailableReceivingInstallation.preservation: Retain this capture plan and any supplied original source bytes; never rewrite as a generic CAD task
unavailableReceivingInstallation.diagnostic: Capture is incomplete; intended Solid Edge provider is unavailable or unverified
unavailableReceivingInstallation.allowedNextAction: Configure a verified instance of the intended provider, or explicitly author a replacement process with a new revision and revalidate
